Recorded behind my apartment building in Birzeit, Ramallah (Palestine) with a different mic position. This ambient recording captures the wind moving through the trees and several cars passing by on a nearby street. No heavy traffic. Just the natural flow of daily life in a quiet residential neighborhood. Perfect for background layers, documentary, or sound design needing authentic Middle Eastern urban atmosphere. 

 -Info about Berzeit from Wikipedia- 

 Birzeit (Arabic: بيرزيت), also Bir Zeit (بير زيت), is a Palestinian Christian town north of Ramallah, in the West Bank. Its population in the 2017 census was 5,878.[2] Birzeit is home to Birzeit University and to the Birzeit Brewery. 

 Location: Palestine, Ramallah, Berzeit. 

 Date/Time: 27/07/2025, 05:50 PM 

 Activity: Sound recording 

 Mic Format: Stereo 

 Recorder: Zoom H5 

 Mics: Clippy XLR EM272Z1

 *The two mics had a fur wind and they were spaced by a stereo bar on a tripod. *Conditions were windy.
